subject: rename redisCommandArgType serverCommandArgType (#182)
reason: The change only renames the C identifiers redisCommandArgType/redisCommandArg to serverCommandArgType/serverCommandArg and updates all references and one comment. The struct layout, the module-API conversion logic (moduleCopyCommandArgs, moduleConvertArgType), and the COMMAND DOCS reply code are byte-for-byte equivalent after the rename; any mistake would fail compilation, not runtime behaviour. No observable behaviour changes, so no scenario can distinguish the builds and none is needed.
